name: Annotations Context
description: Assembles annotation data into structured context payloads and exposes them as a JSON API, an MCP (Model Context Protocol) endpoint, and an admin preview/markdown export.
project_description: Annotations Context assembles a site's annotations into structured, renderable context payloads via ContextAssembler, and delivers them three ways: a cacheable JSON endpoint per target, an MCP (Model Context Protocol) Streamable-HTTP endpoint exposing each target as an MCP resource, and an admin preview page with role simulation and a markdown export. It requires no AI module — it is the shared assembly and delivery layer that annotations_docs, annotations_tool, and annotations_export build on.
